  "categories": [

      "name": "kernel",

      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp only mechanically to update callers to the new CScriptWitness accessor methods.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change the kernel API, boundary, or library behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in src/policy/policy.cpp and mempool tests are mechanical adjustments following the CScriptWitness interface refactor.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter mempool acceptance, eviction algorithms, or policy rules."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/node/miner.cpp only mechanically for CScriptWitness accessor calls.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not alter block template construction, mining RPCs, or mining interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Changes src/net_processing.cpp to drop transactions upfront at the deserialization stage if they have zero inputs/outputs or exceed block weight limits, mitigating network-level memory exhaustion.",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.8,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Mitigates a severe P2P message-handling DoS vector where peers can send blocks or transactions with millions of tiny witness elements that allocate over 100 MiB of memory during deserialization. Author benchmarks show deserialized block memory dropping from 106.8 MiB to 3.8 MiB, directly addressing resource accounting vulnerabilities on the wire."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to RPC files merely adapt existing raw transaction decoders to the new span-based CScriptWitness API.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not add, remove, or modify RPC methods or external interfaces."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Updates unit tests, fuzz harnesses, and benchmarks across the tree to match the new CScriptWitness API and measure block deserialization.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Adds test coverage and benchmarks for witness deserialization changes rather than modifying shared test runners or testing infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits to src/bitcoin-tx.cpp follow mechanically from CScriptWitness method changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change command-line tools or developer helper scripts."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Adds serialization helpers in src/serialize.h to support bounded transaction and witness parsing.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "The additions to serialization primitives are subordinate to transaction and witness structure changes in validation and P2P."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Re-architects CScriptWitness storage and transaction deserialization bounds in consensus and validation critical paths (src/script/script.h, src/primitives/transaction.h, src/script/interpreter.cpp).",
      "band": "P1",
      "score": 0.88,
      "reason_tag": "DoS protection",
      "rationale": "Eliminates an adversarial memory exhaustion vector in block processing where valid 4 MB blocks packed with empty or 1-byte witness elements consumed over 100 MiB of heap memory. Author benchmarks demonstrate block deserialization time falling from 279.2 ms to 18.7 ms and peak allocation dropping from 182.2 MiB to 7.8 MiB, prompting maintainers to schedule it for v33 as a critical fix."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Edits in src/psbt.cpp and wallet files only update callers to use span-based witness accessors.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Does not change wallet transaction generation, signing, coin selection, or database behavior."
    }
  ],
  "factors": {
    "security_stability": 3,
    "bug_severity": 2,
    "performance": 3,
    "user_value": 0,
    "leverage": 1
  }
}
